assessments.reasoning: The matched July 2024 Oracle reference's DoSave entry on printed and PDF page 292 gives end-of-event deferred processing and lists FieldEdit, FieldChange, and ItemSelected only for popup-menu items. It explicitly distinguishes immediate DoSaveNow processing.

challenge.method: Read DoSave and DoSaveNow alongside the exact edition's CallAppEngine FieldChange restriction on p.108. Search the July 2024 PeopleTools 8.60 Component Interfaces guide, pp.67–68, for whether one of the three named events alone guarantees support.
challenge.results: The listed event types are necessary conditions for the documented page save, with no assertion they are sufficient. Same-FieldChange CallAppEngine and component-interface execution supply additional restrictions, consistent with the descriptive claim.

limitations: The event list describes a necessary restriction for supported page processing. DoSave is barred alongside CallAppEngine in the same FieldChange and is unsupported when called through a component interface.
